acceptance_criteria.text: Identical recorded normalized market/account inputs, virtual as_of, identifiers, and transform versions produce byte-identical canonical decision contexts and content hashes.
Returns, spread, exposure and freshness are calculated deterministically with documented rounding; unavailable or stale values remain null with structured reasons and are never replaced by zero.
Every context includes immutable cycle/context identity, symbol, semantic version, built_at, effective as_of, transform versions and ordered source provenance sufficient to reconstruct each input.
The local runtime can persist a context and replay its stored source inputs to reproduce the exact canonical payload and hash, with idempotent writes and explicit conflict detection.
Single-symbol serialized contexts enforce a deterministic token-budget estimate below 4,000 tokens, with tests covering the selected estimation methodology and rejection boundary.
